items.title: Scout - White ULTRA
items.excerpt:
The Sentinel Scout is our take on a universal range finder case. Built with industry leading performance materials and components, the Scout is sure to be a trusted companion. Waterproof from head to toe, easy to use with a quick draw, and made in U.S.A.

Challenge Sailcloth is committed to meeting the rugged demands of adventure-seekers. Their legacy spans four generations, having founded one of the first sailcloth companies in the united states, and they continue to build on it through a dedication to innovation and sustainability.

Product Specs:

Dimensions: Fits 3.5”w x 5”h x 2”d

Face Fabric: Dyneema® Body Fabric / Vinyl Base

Lining Fabric: 1.5mm Neoprene

Fidlock™ Magnet Closure

Matte Black Brass Swivel Hook

Two-Way Waterproof YKK™ Zipper

275 Paracord Zipper Pulls

3/4” Nylon Cordura Utility Webbing

Made in U.S.A.

Face Fabric: 9.3 oz Cordura / X-Pac

Fidlock™ Magnet Closure

275 Paracord Zipper Pulls

items.title: Merino SS Polo - Navy
items.excerpt:
The SS Polo is built for all seasons wear. Light enough and tough enough for most conditions, these classic cut garments are tailored without being slim. Clean lines, quality components, and subtle details round out a work horse layering option. Knit, cut, and sewn in Japan, this rib-knit textile maintains its character and structure with wear.

Additional Specs:

  • Triple needle stitched seams

  • 60% Merino / 40% Polyester (Machine Washable)

  • Kane-M Snap Front

Aprx. Measurements Runs true to size. If in-between sizes, size down.

S: Chest - 20.5” / Shoulder - 17.5” / Front Length - 27”

M: Chest - 21” / Shoulder - 18” / Front Length - 27.5”

L: Chest - 22.5” / Shoulder - 18.5” / Front Length - 28”

XL: Chest - 23.5” / Shoulder - 19” / Front Length - 28.5”

items.excerpt:
The Shag Tube was built by Madewell Products, originators of the BagShag, to be a work horse around the short game range, putting green, and simulator bay. Able to hold 23 balls in total, it is constructed with an aluminum body and stainless steel clips. Finished with a removable rubber tube stop at the top for easy transport.

items.title: Kontex Towel
items.excerpt:
Kontex towels have been woven in Japan since 1935. Their process and equipment remains unchanged ever since, with each towel made from loosely twisted garment quality yarns that provide unrivaled strength and softness. Its fabric is gently woven on traditional, low-speed machines that help to maintain the integrity of the yarn and achieve a level of quality that modern, high-speed machines would be unable to match.

Its size is smaller and more compact than traditional golf bag towels allowing to slide under the handle, still stay out the way when carrying, and easy to use when needed.

Kaweco writing instruments have been made in Germany since 1883. Founded in the back of a Heidelberg carpenter shop, its close proximity to an arts and science college provided a convenient early sales channel and after years of development, the company was awarded a first official patent for fountain pens.

The Mini Special mechanical pencil is built with a satin-gloss aluminum eight-sided frame (a shape introduced by Kaweco in 1913) making it soft and light enough for every day carry but heavy enough to avoid feeling fragile. Its internal mechanics, developed in Japan, allow for a precise draw and its slightly oversized barrel makes it easy to maneuver. A Simple and brilliant tool.

items.title: 1733 Tote - Saltex Charcoal
items.excerpt:
1733 is a detail-heavy design and manufacturing outfit based in Chicago. Our collaboration churns out a material focused take on the classic zip tote/briefcase. Built using triple-layer construction starting with our Saltex Nylon shell, cotton batting mid-layer, then lined with a 400D Packcloth interior. Finished with a 2-way YKK Aquaguard zipper, mil-spec nylon webbing, and hand-tied 275 paracord zipper pulls.

Our Saltex Nylon is woven in Japan with a denser, more rigid structure and carries an organic texture and appearance. This effect is achieved by heat treating the fabric after a salt bath to compress the weave. When exposed to humidity the material will loosen and become more flexible and return to its original state in normal conditions. A DWR coating provides water resistance to round it out.

items.title: No. 16 Basket
items.excerpt:
The first Korbo basket was woven by hand in 1922 by Einar Andersson, in Furufjäll, Sweden.
In the old days, the baskets were used by fishermen and farmers or anyone who needed reliable carrying and storage that could withstand weather, wind, wear and tear.

Each basket has been woven by hand ever since using the exact same technique and tools, made completely without weldings. Behind every basket lies skilled craftsmanship and it takes years to fully master the technique and materials to craft a Korbo basket.

Acid proof stainless steel has a great resistance to corrosion and is often
used in maritime climate. The steel gains its properties through the addition
of various alloys and precious metals helping it to remain shiny
regardless of environmental exposure.

Specs:

  • Acid Proof Steel

  • Made in Sweden

items.title: Dyneema Suit - Olive
items.excerpt:
Constructed with a 4-way stretch Dyneema ripstop that is water repellent, windproof, and breathable to function in windy and damp conditions. Hidden waist and pocket zippers, adjustable waist and ankle shock cord, and finished off with a heavy duty 2-way YKK zipper. Cut and sewn in U.S.A.

Dyneema® is an ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) developed in 1969 and backed by groundbreaking engineering making it the world's strongest fiber™. Composite fabrics are created using layers of bio-based Dyneema® fibers specially designed to deliver the required strength, stretch, weight, and minimum thickness. 

Thanks to its exceptional strength-to-weight ratio, Dyneema® allows for the creation of high-performance, ultra-light gear that offers unparalleled reliability and durability as natural byproducts. Bio-based Dyneema® achieves this while also delivering a 90%-lower carbon footprint than generic HMPE fibers and manufactured with 100% renewable sources of energy in its manufacturing process.

  • YKK 2-Way AquaGuard Zipper (Made in Canada)

  • YKK Hidden Reverse Coil Zipper (Made in Japan)

items.title: ULTRACOMP WALKER 2.0 - BLACK
items.excerpt:
// MADE TO ORDER // SHIPS IN 8-10 WEEKS. ALL SALES FINAL. WE WILL FOLLOW UP FOR MONOGRAM DETAILS AFTER ORDERS ARE SUBMITTED. MADE IN SINGLE POCKET ONLY. NO OTHER CUSTOMIZATION REQUESTS ARE AVAILABLE.

Many products speak of their evolution, however, the MacKenzie Walker was born fully formed and over the years its evolution is more aptly described as refinement, akin to a sculpture. MacKenzie has taken away all unnecessary elements of the golf bag to fulfill its original purpose: carry your clubs, golf balls, and necessities in an elegant and uncomplicated manner.

Our project together keeps these principles intact while exploring a new application to its cloak. ULTRAcomp® is a high-performance laminate that far exceeds the military standard air textured nylon in tear and abrasion resistance. Its hydrophobic features allows products to stay dry and light, whereas air textured nylon retains water and gets even heavier when wet.

This American made, new-age material combines the durability of a polymer based laminate with the benefits of a Cordura® face fabric, a case where the sum is greater than the parts. The combined strengths of the two materials becoming one pushes the limits on design while exceeding established standards of strength and durability.

We are proud to introduce the use of this American made textile innovation to the world of golf.

- Single Divider

- Single Strap

Many products speak of their evolution, however, the MacKenzie Walker was born fully formed and over the years its evolution is more aptly described as refinement, akin to a sculpture. MacKenzie has taken away all unnecessary elements of the golf bag to fulfill its original purpose: carry your clubs, golf balls, and necessities in an elegant and uncomplicated manner.

Our second project together maintains this idea while exploring a new application to its cloak. X-PAC® is a high-performance laminate that far exceeds the military standard air textured nylon in tear and abrasion resistance. Its hydrophobic features allows products to stay dry and light, whereas air textured nylon retains water and gets even heavier when wet.

This 9.3oz American made textile has two distinct layers: a 500 denier Cordura® nylon face bonded to a polyester X-ply mesh reverse. A combination that provides extreme tear and stain resistance, water resistance, and comfort.

items.title: 1733 Shoe Bag - Saltex Coyote
items.excerpt:
1733 is a detail-heavy design and manufacturing outfit based in Chicago. Our collaboration churns out a material focused take on the classic shoe bag. Built using triple-layer construction starting with a Saltex Nylon shell, cotton batting mid-layer, then lined with a 400D Packcloth interior. Saltex Nylon is a special variant of Japanese Nylon that is denser, more rigid, and has an organic texture and appearance. This effect is achieved by heat treating the fabric after a salt bath to compress the weave. When exposed to humidity the material will loosen and become more flexible and return to its original state in normal conditions. A DWR coating provides water resistance to round it out.

items.title: Cerakote Rypstick
items.excerpt:
Dr. Luke Benoit received his PhD in Kinesiology from the University of Minnesota with a focus on human motor control and learning. He also has ranked as a Golf Digest ‘Best Young Teacher’ for the past decade as Head of Instruction at Minnesota’s Interlachen CC. This requisite blend of education and experience lead Luke to design and develop Rypstick in 2020.


The antithesis of a faceless gimmick, Rypstick is built for one purpose: to teach your body to go faster. Conceptually derived from track and field training (running up hill in combination with down hill rather than solely flat ground) the combination of extremes progresses swing speed and form down a singular path.

Our project together utilized a Sentinel-sourced finish to the Rypstick barrel: Cerakote. Developed in 1984, Cerakote is a film-protected ceramic coating used in high performance military, aerospace, and medical applications. Its proprietary formulation allows for increased abrasion and corrosion resistance creating unparalleled strength in comparison to alternative finishes proven both in lab and field testing.

Additional Specs
Length: 45”
Shaft: Graphite (Mid-Stiff)
Barrel: Steel (Cerakote Oven Cure Finish)
Counterweight Grip

Orders include one virtual lesson, access to the Rypstick app, and the ultimate addition of 15-20 yards in distance over 6 weeks or put it back in the mail. Log in info sent upon shipment via Rypstick.

items.title: Felt Target Mat
items.excerpt:
The Felt Target Mat is our experiment based on the traditional at-home putting device. Centered around the concept of ‘aim small, miss small’, this 100% American wool felt panel has a two-piece removable hole system: one 4” donut and one 2” dot allow for full or partial removal of anchoring holes. Built to be an imperfect, natural surface, the felt is laser engraved with alignment markers throughout the panel. Rather than standing in one place hitting putt after putt, the mat is meant to be used with a single ball alternating between sides with each putt to encourage movement and variation.
